messages.subject: Issues Loading Data in Rattle
parts:

(Page 90 of the Data Mining with Rattle Guide

parts:
So you could check the original web site and find it is no longer available - R can't do anything about that I guess and one of the dangers of using examples of web sites out of ones control.

Graham Williams
http://togaware.com
